summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new features (Quick Vitals tap-to-fill chips on New Encounter form + Export Visit Summary PDF on Encounter detail). All acceptance criteria met with zero console/red-screen errors. Vitals autofill works exactly to spec, fields remain freely editable and clearable, encounter save + navigation to detail works, and both PDF export entry points (body button + header share icon) successfully trigger a real PDF blob download via the /api/render/pdf → <a download> web path.
critical_code_review_comments: encounter-pdf.ts falls back to a hardcoded default hostname 'https://www.drsagarjoshi.com' if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is not set — that fallback is only used to build the QR verify URL, but per repo guidelines env vars should not carry a hardcoded default. Consider removing the fallback and letting the caller handle a missing env.

The header share button (encdet-export) and body Export button (encdet-export-btn) share the same handler but only the body button shows a spinner in-place; the header icon does toggle its own spinner via `exporting`. Both render an ActivityIndicator while `exporting` is true, so simultaneous clicks are naturally guarded — no fix needed, just noting duplication.
